value.title: The Shared Goods Terraces
value.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an original still reward panorama for a territory-capture game, not a map or interface.
Generate ONE complete landscape image at exactly 1774 x 887 pixels, 2:1 aspect. Full-frame opaque RGB PNG. Modern luminous pixel-art: deliberate crisp pixel clusters, readable large silhouettes, detailed but ordered surfaces, cinematic depth, natural atmosphere, richly colored light and shadow. Match the series' restrained navy/teal shadows and warm light, with the distinct palette specified below. A beautiful meaningful scene must remain understandable as a 384 x 192 thumbnail. No artificial stretching, panels, collage, text, UI, arrows, borders, watermarks, game screenshots or copied assets. Small people only as scale/story cues, never dominant portraits. All structures and equipment are original fictional designs; do not claim exact real architecture or product reconstruction.
Scene: a fictional cooperative receiving and repair district with three unequal stepped brick courtyards linked by a central ramp-and-stair route. One terrace has a small tool-sharing workshop, another careful parcel sorting with simple unbranded crates, and the upper terrace a sunlit community greenhouse. Small workers pass an object hand-to-hand near a clear worktable. Spend Network / Coupa theme as human cooperation and stewardship, not an actual Coupa product, interface, financial claim or measured sustainability result. No logos, text, charts or readable ledgers.
Lighting/palette: clear spring late afternoon, terracotta brick, fresh sage plants, warm cream walls and cool teal shade. Strong unequal terrace volumes and welcoming pools of light; useful daily work, not a fantasy luxury market.
